title: ECO-FORMS + DSM + HUMANITARIANS — Florence Nightingale, Jonas Salk, Hippocrates. The identity hook.
summary: Mine the DSM (Diagnostic and Statistical Manual) and all of human medicine from Hippocrates to NOW and back. Follow Jonas Salk inventing the polio vaccine. Meet Florence Nightingale. Humanitarians are an eco-form. THE is the identity hook — 'the naturalist', 'the mathematician', 'the humanitarian'. Kevin IS the naturalist (like Darwin). Mendel IS the alchemist. Euler IS the mathematician. Florence Nightingale IS the humanitarian. 'THE' can change on either side but the main identity is the corner.

eco_forms.what: Categories of human excellence. Each eco-form = a way of being in the world.
eco_forms.the_hook: 'THE ___' is the identity hook. The article 'the' pins the identity. It's a definite article = definite identity.
eco_forms.corners: Each person has a CORNER identity (their main eco-form) and satellite identities (other roles they play). Kevin's corner = naturalist. He might also be artisan, but naturalist is the corner.

florence_nightingale.title: THE humanitarian
florence_nightingale.key_insight: She didn't just nurse — she COUNTED. She invented the polar area diagram (coxcomb chart) to show that more soldiers died of infection than combat. DATA + COMPASSION = lives saved.
florence_nightingale.data_as_medicine: Her charts convinced the British government to reform army medical care. The VISUALIZATION was the treatment.
florence_nightingale.connection_to_gaia: Gaia also visualizes data to reveal truth. The HUD IS a Nightingale chart — data made visible to compel action.

jonas_salk.title: THE immunologist
jonas_salk.key_insight: Use the enemy AS the shield. Kill the virus, inject it, the body learns to fight the live version.
jonas_salk.refused_patent: Could you patent the sun? The vaccine belongs to the people.
jonas_salk.connection_to_gaia: Gaia's immune system (thymus, negative selection) works the same way — learn what is NOT-self to protect self.

the_identity_hook.the: THE is a definite article. It pins identity. 'A naturalist' = anyone. 'THE naturalist' = Darwin.
the_identity_hook.mutable: The sides can change (Kevin might be THE artisan tomorrow) but the corner is the primary identity
